q: Which job is an AI gateway best placed to do?
options: Fail over between providers and enforce spend limits
explain: Gateways centralize routing, failover, logging and budgets.

q: Why should services call logical model names through a gateway?
options: Mappings to providers and versions can change centrally, with evals, without touching every service
explain: One place to route, fall back and pin versions.

q: What must every fallback route have before it is enabled?
options: Eval evidence that its model handles the route’s prompts and formats
explain: Untested fallbacks turn outages into correctness incidents.

q: What does a learned router such as RouteLLM predict?
options: Whether a cheaper model will answer a request well enough
explain: It routes easy requests to cheaper models.
